newsitem.title: USA: US FERC approves market rates for C&SW power unit.
newsitem.headline: US FERC approves market rates for C&SW power unit.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission Wednesday approved plans by a subsidiary of Central and South West Corp to sell bulk power at open market rates.

The commission approved the request by CSW Power Marketing to sell power at market-based rates because Central and South West is now offering equal access on its transmission lines to all power producers, including its subsidiary and competitors.

The FERC last year rejected a similar application by the power marketing unit because Central and South West had not established an open access tariff at the time, which would have given its affiliate an unfair advantage over competitors.
CSW Power said it planned to market and broker power and energy and energy services nationwide from its non-public utility affiliates and other electric utilities.

"We now have to take stock where we actually want to do the marketing," said Sabrina Campbell, regulatory consultant for Central and South West, who added that the company was eager to be able to compete with power marketing units of other big utilities.
